name: permanent neonatal diabetes mellitus-pancreatic and cerebellar agenesis syndrome
description: Permanent neonatal diabetes mellitus-pancreatic and cerebellar agenesis syndrome is characterized by neonatal diabetes mellitus associated with cerebellar and/or pancreatic agenesis.
